authority: User explicitly approved only seed=2026 T0 and original region-weighted TW 2/2, each continuing its own existing complete step-2000 checkpoint to step 4000, 2000 new successful updates each; Luna implements and executes after the targeted gate passes. No further startup confirmation is needed inside this scope.
purpose: Post-hoc exploratory budget diagnosis: distinguish continued optimization, whole-image Dice change and hemorrhage-neighborhood thin-skeleton recall; do not rewrite the completed 2000-step formal negative result.

parent_protocol.scope: Inherit scientific model/data/loss/evaluation rules only. Override prior fresh starts, three-seed budget, step-2000 endpoint and three-seed aggregation solely as explicitly specified here.

authorization.executor: Luna in the existing engineering conversation; handoff through the existing server STATUS.md

gpu.readiness: 仅使用既有GPU0，在原显存/利用率/无其他计算进程条件满足时运行；繁忙则等待或记录阻塞，不杀他人任务

authorization.after_gate: Allowed to execute exactly these two continuation trajectories and necessary evaluation/analysis/records.
forbidden: Other seeds, 2/1 or any other weighting variant
Architecture, loss, coefficient, masks, split, normalization or augmentation changes
Official Test data access, including engineering checks
Restarting from M0 or reinitializing optimizer/scaler/RNG
Overwriting old experiment files or frozen code/protocols
Other projects, GitHub changes, synchronization or cleanup
Additional trajectories or budget beyond global step 4000

required_restoration: Each method restores its OWN model, full AdamW first/second moments and step counters, AMP scaler, Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG, sampling cursor and configuration lineage.
Parent optimizer states differ between T0 and TW as expected; restore each exactly, do not require optimizer/model equality between methods.

Restore state after model/optimizer construction and validate digests before forward/backward. DataLoader uses the same private seeded generator; evaluation in separate processes does not perturb training RNG.

On interruption resume only from the last complete child checkpoint; retain and align discarded log tails by the proven prior mechanism, record discarded attempts, never count uncheckpointed replays as extra unique successful updates.
If state, source binding, cursor, same-input pairing or numerical continuation cannot be guaranteed, stop and report; do not silently restart or relax the protocol.

learning_rate.rule: Continue constant 0.0001 from the saved optimizer state for global steps 2001 through 4000.

configuration_rule.scientific_values: All numerical training fields must match the method-specific parent config and checkpoint, including optimizer values and initial AMP configuration; runtime scaler state is restored as saved (scale 2048, growth tracker 0), not initialized anew.
configuration_rule.additional_metadata: Parent path/hash, start step/draw, parent config/binding and new execution binding may be stored separately with explicit lineage. Never alter or relabel the original checkpoint/config.
configuration_rule.child_binding: New child checkpoints bind the new implementation/protocol/config plus immutable parent checkpoint/config/binding hashes.

data_and_regions.input: RGB only；H/U/V只用于既定训练权重或监督/评价，不增加模型输入通道
data_and_regions.V: 既定 Vessels 标注，按原原生尺寸读取器解释
data_and_regions.FOV: 沿用已绑定的 RGB candidate_fov；不得用标签修补
native_region_order: 读取完整原图RGB、V、H、U和既定FOV，不resize
r=max(1,ceil(native_RGB_width/100))；对完整原图 H 做欧氏圆盘膨胀 D
在完整原图生成w，再按同一裁剪/翻转/逆时针90度旋转同步处理RGB/V/FOV/w；不得按裁块重建邻域
data_and_regions.weight_TW: Rin∪Rnear 内 w=2；其余 FOV内 w=1（包括U）；FOV外不计入损失
data_and_regions.U_training: 不忽略U；U与普通区域一样按1参与BCE和原Dice；仅从区域评价及额外加权排除

loss.normalization: 每张裁块分别归一化，再批平均。TW分母使用实际FOV内权重和，不能沿用未加权像素数或跨批统一分母。w作用于该位置的正/负标签BCE，不只作用于血管正类。
invariants: w全1时损失值和logits梯度与既有 masked_loss 一致
不能把F*w代入整套masked_loss从而连Dice也改变

training.sampling: manifest_order_four_round_robin_passes_per_epoch；每轮440draw；每图4次裁剪；继承原 draw_geometry SeedSequence([seed,global_draw]) 与裁剪/翻转/旋转顺序，原相同概率不变
training.determinism: 沿用确定性算法、cudnn deterministic=true benchmark=false、TF32=false、threads=2、AdamW foreach=false；DataLoader私有seed发生器；评价独立进程且不改变训练随机状态。
training.successful_update_semantics: 仅成功优化器更新计步；溢出时沿用原同一批重试与有限次数保护，记录实际scaler/重试；不同方法损失/梯度/权重及相应优化轨迹不同是预期，不要求TW与T0参数相等。
training.runtime_safety: 沿用原GPU安全锁和7200秒安全分段/恢复保护；不是总预算缩减或新科研停止规则。
training.pairing: Same filename order, global draws, geometry and RGB/V/FOV tensors for all 8000 new draws. Log every successful update with its four global draws and input tensor digests; compare all 2000 paired update rows. Only the pre-existing BCE weight maps and resulting optimization trajectories differ.

evaluation.definition_scope: 原评价配置中主/补充指标、掩码、分母、推理、NA规则沿用；selection、calibration_max_updates等校准专属项只适用旧阶段。本协议明确覆盖正式选模、保护参照和统计规则，不能整份旧配置盲拷冒充正式协议。

primary.name: near_thin_recall_d1_diameter_le3
primary.aggregation: 每图比率后宏平均，不按77点池化

inference.normalization: 同原M0/FIVES冻结归一化；FOV外输入0
inference.probability: 原尺寸float32；概率>=阈值；保存来源模型/图像及推理绑定摘要

evaluation.reuse_rule: Reuse seed-2026 T0/TW 2000-step metrics/per-image counts and endpoint probability maps read-only, with source hashes. Do not rerun 0-2000 training or count reused evaluations as new evidence.
supplementary_metrics: original diameter <=2/4/5 thin skeleton supplements at endpoints
evaluation.NA: 沿用既有计数/分母0=>NA，报告每项有效图ID与n；固定参考图，不按方法更换有效集合；任何预期n/分母改变或预测异常均暂停对比查明，不事后填0。
evaluation.storage: Retain all 20 new complete checkpoints, fixed-0.5 per-image counts/denominators/NA and aggregate metrics. Save 56 native float32 endpoint probability maps (28 per method at step 4000) with binding.
evaluation.main_endpoint: Global step 4000 only; intermediate evaluations are curves, never best-model candidates.

comparisons.primary: At fixed 0.5, per-image TW(4000)-T0(4000), original diameter <=3 near thin-skeleton d1 recall.
comparisons.relationship_change: Per-image [TW(4000)-T0(4000)]-[TW(2000)-T0(2000)]; report this paired difference of differences with its interval.
comparisons.absolute_reference: Report T0/TW absolute values and changes relative to the same Z0@0.5 without reinterpreting the original calibration or formal outcomes.
comparisons.curve_analysis: Show 2000-4000 loss and fixed-threshold curves separately. Train-loss plots summarize integer 110-update sampling cycles, preserving raw values. Total training losses across T0 and TW have different objectives and are not directly comparable. Do not invent BCE/Dice historical components absent from original logs.

same_FP.role: 终点描述性补充，不用于选模或拯救主结果；同一开发集拟合和评价，不是独立Test
same_FP.reference: 同一Z0@0.5的全部28图宏平均FP/FOV，不是各seed T0各自目标
same_FP.grid: np.linspace(0,1,1001,dtype=np.float32)，含两端，保存网格数值与实现
same_FP.selection: 对每个method/seed终点各选一个全局阈值；全部28图宏平均FP/FOV<=共同目标的最小可行阈值；不增加科学容忍epsilon；无可行=>NA并报告原因
report: 全部网格FP密度与可行标记
所选阈值、实际误报、相对目标差距、有效图n
所选全局阈值下逐图/逐点计数与指标、TW−T0配对补充差
逐图误报增减，不能将宏均值不超目标称为每图误报受控
not_allowed: 多次尝试选最有利网格/目标
把留一图开发敏感性描述为独立验证
same_FP.reuse_2000: Reuse existing seed-2026 2000 endpoint probabilities/grids read-only where compatible; compute only required supplementary outputs into the new experiment.
same_FP.scope: Two methods, seed 2026; report method and temporal contrasts. No intermediate-checkpoint threshold fitting.

protection.contrast: TW(4000)-paired T0(4000), fixed threshold 0.5; also report the observed 2000-step paired protection and each method temporal costs.
protection.clear_support: Precision and far_recall paired-image 95% interval lower bounds >=0, FP/FOV upper bound <=0, all three required.
protection.report_costs: Report any mean degradation and all per-image deterioration; an interval crossing a protection boundary is insufficient support, not proof of non-inferiority.
protection.calibration: Original Z0-based calibration and completed formal three-seed conclusions remain unchanged.

statistics.aggregation: Per-image ratios and differences then image macro mean. Do not average nonexistent seeds or report single-seed SD as 0.

bootstrap.unit: 整图配对，有放回，样本量保持该指标有效n
bootstrap.indices: Use dev_manifest fixed effective-ID order. For each n initialize PCG64(20261016), draw a (1000,n) integer index table; reuse for every metric/contrast of the same n. Save indices and estimates. There is one seed, no three-seed aggregation.

statistics.interval_scope: Descriptive paired-image intervals conditional on seed 2026; not training-seed or patient-general uncertainty.
statistics.use_same_indices: All metrics sharing the same valid n and all temporal/method/interaction contrasts reuse the exact frozen index table; build effective IDs in dev_manifest order.
statistics.NA: 指标固定有效集合按原分母确定；若预期有效图中某方法产生额外NA，不能pairwise删除/更换样本，应记录不可比较并排查；不伪造置信区间。
report: All 28 image identities, original 9 primary IDs/77 positions and 19 NA
Per-image values, numerators/denominators, absolute and paired changes
Macro estimates, 1000 bootstrap indices/estimates and 95% linear-quantile intervals
Single paired seed explicitly labeled; seed variation NA, not a three-seed result
limits: Post-hoc development-set budget exploration after observing 2000-step curves
Seed 2026 and development images reused from calibration and formal work
Small primary sample of 9 images/77 positions; patient independence unknown
Do not treat checkpoints, image-by-time observations or skeleton positions as independent replicates

interpretation.primary_support: Positive point estimate and primary paired-image 95% lower bound >0 may support a within-seed exploratory signal only; require all protection intervals before describing a protected signal. Never claim that the original three-seed success criterion was met.
interpretation.budget_support: Evaluate T0 and TW temporal primary changes, seeds being fixed, jointly with Dice and observed precision/FP/far-recall costs. A falling train loss or rising global Dice alone is insufficient to establish primary convergence or useful fine-vessel gains.
interpretation.no_result_contingent_design: No extra seeds, duration, threshold selection or rule changes to rescue unfavorable results. Any further research decision returns to user and Sol.

implementation.new_entry: retinal_m0/maples_budget_extension.py and necessary new same-scope helpers/tests; Luna binds exact paths/hashes.
implementation.reuse: Read-only reuse of bound CorePatches, weighted_masked_loss, UNet, state/geometry, tiled inference and metric primitives.
implementation.old_entry_warning: Old core worker caps target at parent max_steps=2000 and binds output/config to the old experiment. Implement an explicit child continuation entry; do not mutate old globals, monkeypatch hardcoded roots or modify old checkpoint configs to fool checks. The old evaluation save-probability condition step==2000 must not be blindly reused for the new 4000 endpoint.
implementation.cli: No default implicit training. Require explicit continuation operation, seed/method/source and validated new output root/protocol/binding.

layout.gate: implementation_gate/verification.json plus restoration and real-input evidence
layout.analysis: analysis/ with fixed per-image tables, all method/temporal/interaction contrasts, same-FP grid and bootstrap indices

implementation.new_run_logs: Only global steps 2001-4000, 2000 unique successful updates and 8000 draws per method. Reused old logs stay separate, never duplicated as new updates.
implementation.execution_binding: Luna generates exact new implementation/config/environment bindings to frozen protocol/source manifest and parent states; changed new code invalidates the gate and requires rechecking the affected checks without extra GPU training.
implementation.handoff: Only existing server STATUS current handoff; no parallel project status or model memory.

engineering_gate.Sol_completed: CPU source/hash/config/optimizer/cursor checks and exact model/optimizer reload; terminal RNG/scaler equality; 12 future real-input samples per method. This is not the Luna implementation gate.
required_checks: Verify frozen protocol/source hashes, original checkpoint SHA and all protected files. No new source may be imported under an old binding.

Restore each own model/AdamW/AMP scaler/Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG on GPU0; compare actual restored-state digests with its source checkpoint before any update; optimizer counters=2000 and learning rate=0.0001 with scheduler=None.

Assert start cursor=8000, epoch=18, position=80, first new step=2001; compute all 8000 planned future filename/geometry records and verify both methods use the same continuation sequence without reset.
Verify real RGB/V/FOV/geometry digests for all 12 source_manifest future-input samples and their full-image mask rules; bind their sources. Ensure loss weighting does not consume sampling RNG.
Check new continuation config against its parent with exactly the allowed metadata overrides. T0/TW config differences remain only original method/loss plus lineage metadata.

Use existing validated loss implementation, inspect its use in the new entry and run targeted CPU no-update tests for continuation boundary, source rejection, logging, max-step guard, endpoint probability saving and evaluation/statistics schema. No extra GPU short-training or optimizer updates.
Validate per-method recovery and source-vs-child lineage without writing old files; preserve full state and maintain global step/draw counters.
Write actual checks/evidence/code/config/protocol hashes and all_passed before either training worker may update parameters.
runtime_checks: Validate actual full paired 2000 update rows/8000 draws, not only a prefix.
GPU0 readiness and existing project lock; busy means wait/report, never kill another job.
Each method reaches step=4000, next_draw=16000, optimizer step=4000, with exactly 2000 new successful updates.
engineering_gate.failure: Stop and report if scientific equivalence, LR continuation, source identity, full-state restore, pair fairness or data/protocol integrity cannot be guaranteed; no fresh retraining fallback.

criteria: Gate passed for exact executing binding before updates; only seed 2026 T0 and original TW.
Full restore and all new paired input/draw rows verified; old outputs, protocols and bound source hashes unchanged.
All 28 fixed development images/9 primary images/77 positions/19 NA retained.
Primary, temporal and difference-of-differences statistics and guardrail costs reproducible from actual outputs.
Same-FP only supplementary; full grid and selected global thresholds reproducible.
No official Test access, best-checkpoint selection or unauthorized extra training.
All required reports/manifests/closure evidence really exist; any issue explicitly recorded rather than claimed complete.
Negative, positive or inconclusive outcomes equally satisfy engineering acceptance when complete, fair and reproducible.
Luna writes real implementation/validation/results/limitations into existing STATUS then stops for Sol scientific review.

resource_estimate.basis: Prior paired seed-2026 runs: about 0.774 training hours plus 20 evaluations at about 40 seconds each, excluding engineering/debug overhead. Estimate, not a training or wall-time stop rule.
